summary: Blaze Type's template microsite for Surt, a 60-style variable sans (wdth, wght, slnt) 'inspired by Norse mythology and Scandinavian architecture': a 3D stone ampersand in a Nordic landscape, small grey label tabs and green control pills, pointer-driven axis panels, a weight-ramp marquee, a stylistic-set picker, a pairing tester with the foundry's other fonts and a carousel wall of real client work.

instances.look: A rendered stone ampersand floating and turning above a rocky coastal ridge under a hazy sky, inset 10px on white; a mute toggle bottom-right and small grey 'INTRODUCTION' / 'CREDITS' tabs along the bottom edge; no name
instances.ux: The 3D glyph rotates (different angles across the storyboard); sound toggle; clicking the video scrolls to the content; a sticky bar (Blaze Type / Buy Surt / Download Trial) appears after scrolling
instances.learn: Render one characteristic glyph as a physical monument in a landscape that matches the font's mythology: mood before name

reconstruction.layout: Box x=10, y=40, 1420×785 (~87vh), media object-fit cover; mute icon 36px bottom-right; label tabs at the bottom edge
reconstruction.typography: No display type; tab labels ~10px Surt caps in grey #6e6e6e pills with white text
reconstruction.behaviour: Looping 3D render (video, here a placeholder image) of the '&' turning; .btn-mute swaps sound icons; click → smooth scroll to one viewport down
reconstruction.assets: 3D rendered stone '&' composited into a landscape (video loop)
reconstruction.html: section.section-poster > video.intro-poster-bg (commented out) / img.poster + div.btn-mute > svg.icon-sound-off + svg.icon-sound-on

instances.look: Grey 'INTRODUCTION' label tab and a five-line paragraph in black at ~22px across the left two-thirds; the sticky Blaze Type / Buy Surt bar overlaps its top in the capture
instances.learn: A small UI-style label tab above each section keeps a long, varied page feeling like one tool

reconstruction.layout: Column x=40, 893px wide (left ~2/3); label pill above; right third holds the credits table (separate instance)
reconstruction.typography: ~22px Surt Regular, leading ~1.25, black; label 10px caps white on #6e6e6e, radius 4px
reconstruction.content: 'This typeface family, inspired by Norse mythology and Scandinavian Architecture, draws a bridge between a geometric sans and a human process…'

instances.look: Not cut as a block: in the right column beside the intro, a 'CREDITS' tab over a ruled two-column fact table (Designed by Matthieu Salvaggio · Released in 2020 · Styles Upright, Italic, Normal, Expanded, Extended · Export .OTF .WOFF .WOFF2 .TTF (Variable) · Developed for Latin European Languages ▾)
instances.ux: The languages row expands as a dropdown; the hero's 'CREDITS' tab jumps here
instances.learn: Put the colophon facts (designer, year, styles, formats, languages) at the top as a spec table, not at the end

reconstruction.layout: Right column x≈950–1400; 5 rows ~22px with hairline rules; label left, value right-aligned
reconstruction.behaviour: details/summary dropdown for the language list
reconstruction.content: Designer, release year, styles, export formats, languages

instances.look: A 'SPECS' tab followed by three bright-green pills, each holding a label and a tiny white slider (WIDTH, WEIGHT, SLANT), above a paragraph about the 60-font family set at wdth 100, wght 324, slnt -3.5
instances.ux: Drag the mini sliders to restyle the specs paragraph live (wdth 100–200, wght 100–900, slnt -10–0)
instances.learn: Embed the axis sliders in the section's label row so the description paragraph itself becomes the tester

reconstruction.behaviour: input[type=range] wdth/wght/slnt → font-variation-settings on the paragraph
reconstruction.content: Real family description (60 fonts, Expanded and Extended, small caps, alternate numerals, fractions)

instances.learn: Set each style name in itself in width columns × roman/italic: 60 styles fit in one short band
